about: sdn_classify's blind held-out set (C1939), built 2026-11-02 by a fresh context that never saw the classifier's prompt or the schema's guidance, from the locked answer key (tests/fixtures/blind_sets/sdn_classify/blind_answer_key.md, sha256 11a6ccee4457525106f3fd72fd209021c618faf5f06f9519f496bd0d1c5a851a; its draw blind_draw.json) and Mercury's evidence packs as kept when each detection fired in the blind runs of 2026-10-29 (sessions 1 to 3, the operator's run notes). One case per response the loop raised (the detection it would classify); a switch's sighting that joined another response as seen also is not a case. Each section is the pack's sdn section exactly as kept. Each detection is the loop's, rebuilt from its pack: the pack's detection piece, its key the alert's fingerprint (checked equal to detect.detection_key of its rule, network, connection, switch and subject), its subject from the alert's labels, and for a flood its sources the source addresses of the flows it rests on (the flood rule's own _flow_sources); the responses record was not read (it is in the network's data folder under data/lists/, which this builder was told not to read), so a field the loop kept beside these (its incident stamp) is absent; none of those is read by the classifier or its check. The packs predate C2237's reply marking: a flood's victim and a transfer's receivers are named sources here, as the loop named them then. Expectations are the key's rows, never edited, translated to the judge's fields: a scan's action rate_limit_source (the key's scan line), a flood's rate_limit_source or drop_source (the key's flood line, drop where allowed: the SDN lab's flood policy allows it), an unauthorised flow's remove_flow, a benign row's threat_detected false, threat_type none, severity none and action none; the severity the row's own; cites_any the ids the detection rests on as sent (an unauthorised flow's, the flow itself); where a response's own expectation is not written in the key (a link port naming no source, a victim or receiver named as the source, the scan rule's fallback firing on a flood), the case's edit says what the key's words imply and why. Counts: S1 1, S4 1, S3 1, BS1 1, BS3 1, F3 6, F5 1, F6 8, BF2 2, BF3 5, BF1 2, U1 1, U3 1, U6 1, BU1 1, BU2 1, BU3 2, BS4 1 (37 cases from 18 scenarios). Packs used, in case order: ep-00f0a03400c827b9ac08, ep-86ffe61067d8db7b4b6b, ep-80d2f5d87d7cd69e5555, ep-e9344f29510d568ac651, ep-f8b97781b3a801dd0672, ep-30e3356f363b015815cc, ep-1fb9e1e5c167f63c451d, ep-af29293ce17c0b4dfccd, ep-92c3979da1189a576972, ep-f3291778f750c391e33a, ep-e892e0f7043c5c99d963, ep-33af608da07cdf13bbf1, ep-ba55d140fd4922537309, ep-8532a0153ed661d15bb7, ep-287e11e5353ed83a2bea, ep-e1dff2c6603f7a995766, ep-5226c535a847b7b17f10, ep-c5afadc1b441c41b7dfe, ep-c32a7033d505fdbbb885, ep-5b00b8b56c6af0c2ed02, ep-4a0dc6f8ff404487379f, ep-fcad6925a1f62e02da0f, ep-698abee0012d0d37712e, ep-be64d2a43ec0432247d8, ep-ddc3bdb84f760baa3af4, ep-1d3e9718cd7c5c44fa8c, ep-e7e988421ac56b4a2333, ep-da9bb69b452f7bfe2c67, ep-7f899b72632bb92eab3a, ep-5861d41620c1e39c8a96, ep-b3bedac1ef3518e64910, ep-503637a2a3d06969185a, ep-337fdc53a3ed90948978, ep-cf517d25269ddadeb305, ep-2e56ed5d9166d7935b63, ep-d4a47e92099d10aadea8, ep-119b1a1f3c1e96b4000f. BS4 (case 37, added after the first 36 were built, which keep their numbers): its key row lists two whole answers that differ in threat_detected, so its expect is an any_of with one alternative per answer the row lists, an answer passing if any one alternative passes (the operator's rule: any listed alternative counts; the judge and the checker take any_of). Left out: N1 and N2 (the normal-traffic rows of the draw), not yet captured, to come once the operator runs them. Moved 2026-11-02 ~20:4x UTC (the operator's blind discipline): the 26 cases whose misses the prompt's author read after the first round (each failed at least one run, and its first miss, naming expected and answered values, was printed) moved to tests/fixtures/ai_cases/sdn_classify/recorded_from_blind.json; the 11 left (the 10 reliable in the first round, only their pass seen, and BS4, scored after it, only its pass count seen) stay blind, their numbers kept.
